title: Data reference (URF pointer at a Reference Data Layer)
description: The canonical in-field reference to shared, governed data (UDLM ADR-012): a pointer at a Reference Data Layer, never an inlined copy. A URF reference string (identifier-scheme §9), not an object: `uuid/<v4>[@version][?reference_data_type==<kind>]`. It MUST resolve to an ACTIVE `layer` record with layer_type: reference_data and the declared reference_data_type (docs/spec/foundations/layering-and-versioning.md §3.7). registry/tools/validate.py (check_data_references) fails hard on a dangling uuid, kind mismatch, or pin disagreeing with the resolved version. A field allowing reference or inline value $refs $defs/data_reference on one oneOf branch.

data_reference.description: A pointer at IMMUTABLE reference-data (DCM ADR-012), a URF reference (identifier-scheme §9): `uuid/<v4>[@version][?reference_data_type==<kind>]`. The uuid path is AUTHORITATIVE; a change is a NEW record linked by `supersedes`, never an edit. Pin = version; query term = expected kind, which the resolved layer must match. The authority axis (`//state.mn/uuid/<v4>`) is ADR-038 §10's routing root, *who* resolves it; `residency` is what you resolve *to* (filterable as `?residency==state.mn`). No advisory name travels (DRV-001: derive, don't store). Distinct from a resource Reference (common-elements §2.5).
